logo._spec: ~/buttsstudios/design/DESIGN_DIRECTIONS.md: square + X, stroke 12 of 100, X into the corners; Archivo Bold stacked Butts / Studios. Inline SVG copied from ~/buttsstudios/site/index.html.

copy.intro: Books, comics, channels, cartoons and art. The clothes come from the same studio.
copy.notifyIntro: One email when it opens. Nothing else.
copy.exchangeLine: Size exchanges within 14 days of delivery.
copy.checkoutOff: Checkout opens when the shop does.
copy.c27Intro: Lamps, power, air and seating for the desk and the room. Planned for 2027.
copy.c27Note: Every piece starts on the waitlist. When a piece opens for reservations or orders, the waitlist hears first. Images are concept renders; sizes and specs are still being set.

shipping.note: US shipping only at launch. Rate set per drop.

policies.contact_status: placeholder: confirm the inbox before launch. Domain has no MX record on 2026-10-14, so mail to it bounces
policies.exchange_shipping: you pay to send the piece back; we pay to ship the new size to you
policies.preorder_cancel: yes, for a full refund. Email us with your order number
policies.returns: Size exchanges within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unworn with tags.
policies._note: Policy pages (privacy, terms, returns, shipping, policies hub) render from core/policies.mjs. Every [CONFIRM] value and every *_status placeholder blocks a live build.
policies._note_2026_10_18: Pre-launch defaults set by the storefront lane (returns 14 days, exchange shipping split, 7-year order records, pre-orders cancellable before the window closes). Still open before live: mailing_address + governing_law (JARVIS L1) and a working contact inbox (SETUP_TODO email-routing rows).

_orders: Order emails (core/email.mjs): the shop notification goes to orders_inbox; the customer confirmation comes from orders_from as from_name. PLACEHOLDER inboxes: confirm they exist (and verify the domain in Resend) before live checkout.

release_states._note: Labels and helper lines for release-managed items (catalog `release`; core/catalog.mjs RELEASE_COPY has the defaults). Change any word here; no code. {window} = the item's release.window, {limit} = its reserve_limit. Principal 2026-10-26: Order (in stock) / Pre-order (paid, ship window, checkout open) / Reserve (free, holds a place, not an order; capped by reserve_limit) / Waitlist (not taking reservations, or reservations full; reason shown).

preorder.helper: Paid now, made after the pre-order window closes. Ships {window}.

reserve.helper: Reserving holds your place. It isn't an order and you won't be charged.
reserve.terms: Places are kept in the order they arrive. When orders open, everyone who reserved gets a {priority_window} head start by email before the public.
reserve.done: Your place is held. We'll email you before orders open to everyone.

waitlist.helper: We'll email you when it's available to reserve or order.
waitlist.done: You're on the waitlist. We'll email you when it's available to reserve or order.

footer._note: Mirrors the buttsstudios.com footer (~/buttsstudios/site/index.html): Work, Studio, Shop, Contact, with absolute links back to the main site; Shop = this shop's own pages. Principal 2026-10-26. Policy links + main-site link are appended by the core.
footer.note: Images in the shop are concept renders.
